title: Nexus Configuration
description: Configuration file for the Nexus framework and CLI.

paths.description: Customizes the directory paths used by the CLI when generating components.

layers.description: Directory where generated Layer files are placed.

events.description: Directory where generated Event files are placed.

services.description: Directory where generated Service files are placed.

tests.description: Root directory for generated test files.

naming.description: Controls naming conventions applied to generated files.

appendSuffix.description: When true, appends the component type suffix (e.g. 'Layer', 'Event', 'Service') to generated file names.

logging.description: Controls the behaviour of the Nexus Log utility at runtime.

level.description: Minimum log level to emit. Messages below this level are suppressed.

timestamps.description: When true, a timestamp is prepended to every log message.

tests.description: When true, a corresponding test file is generated alongside each new component.
